configuration.title: Simple Launcher
command.menu.title: Command Menu
command.menu.import-commands: Import Commands from supported config files like package.json and Cargo.toml
configuration.load-from.description: Load commands from supported project files.
configuration.load-from.package-json.des: Read commands from the scripts field in package.json. The script key is used as displayName, and the script value is used as command.
configuration.load-from.cargo-toml.descr: Read members from [workspace] in Cargo.toml, resolve each member's Cargo.toml, and read [package].name. The [package].name value is used as displayName, and the command becomes cargo run --bin [package].name.
configuration.custom-commands.displayNam: The display name shown in the UI. If omitted, the command itself is used.
configuration.custom-commands.monitorTar: The process name or regex pattern string to monitor. If omitted, monitoring is disabled.
